basis.title: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Fans and Blowers (notice of proposed rulemaking), 89 FR 3714, January 19, 2024
basis.by: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy
basis.label: Equipment Lifetime: GFBs, "15 years in the commercial sector based on the expected lifetimes of HVAC equipment"
basis.note: Printed page 3788. Commercial-sector lifetime for general fans and blowers (all fan types). Proposed rule; the 15 years is borrowed from HVAC equipment lifetimes, not fan data.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
